name: aether-renju
description: 连珠 / 五子棋引擎:Rust → WebAssembly,无禁(自由)与有禁(RIF 禁手)双规则、PVS 迭代加深 + 双槽置换表 + VCT 证明搜索,Worker 契约与旧 JS 版兼容

scripts.build: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/aether_renju.wasm wasm/ && node scripts/check-size.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:rs && npm run test:wasm
